description: Self-improving memory distillation loop - auto-extract conversation trajectories and optimize agent prompts via langmem

userStories.title: Backend: Trajectory extraction TaskIQ task
userStories.description: As a system, I need to extract conversation trajectories after each session so they can be used for prompt optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: extract_trajectory TaskIQ task accepts thread_id, user_id, assistant_id
Loads conversation messages from thread
Derives quality signals: conversation length, tool success rate, HITL rejections
Formats data as AnnotatedTrajectory (langmem.prompts.types)
Stores trajectory in (user_id, 'trajectories', assistant_id) namespace
Existing tests pass (make test)
userStories.notes: TaskIQ tasks at backend/src/workers/tasks.py. Use AsyncPostgresStore namespaces.

userStories.title: Backend: Hook trajectory extraction into stream persistence
userStories.description: As a system, I need trajectory extraction to run automatically after every conversation completes.
acceptanceCriteria: _persist_final_state() dispatches extract_trajectory task after persisting state
Extraction is non-blocking (dispatched as background TaskIQ task)
Extraction failure does not affect conversation persistence
Existing tests pass (make test)

userStories.title: Backend: PromptOptimizer.distill() method
userStories.description: As a system, I need to distill accumulated trajectories into improved prompts using langmem's optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: distill(user_id, assistant_id) retrieves recent trajectories from store
Runs existing PromptOptimizer.optimize() with retrieved trajectories
Stores optimized prompt as new revision via PromptService.revision()
Returns revision_id or None if no improvement detected
Handles edge case: no trajectories available (returns None gracefully)
Existing tests pass (make test)

userStories.title: Backend: Scheduled daily distillation job
userStories.description: As a system, I need prompt distillation to run on a daily schedule for active agents.
acceptanceCriteria: Scheduled job type 'prompt_distillation' added to APScheduler infrastructure
Runs daily (CronTrigger) for agents with accumulated trajectories
Skips agents with no new trajectories since last distillation
Job errors are logged but don't crash the scheduler
Existing tests pass (make test)
userStories.notes: APScheduler at backend/src/services/schedule.py. Follow existing scheduled_llm_invoke pattern.

userStories.title: Backend: Manual distillation API endpoint
userStories.description: As an agent creator, I want to manually trigger prompt distillation so I can optimize my agent's prompt on demand.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /assistants/{id}/distill requires authentication
Validates caller owns the assistant
Triggers immediate distillation
Returns {revision_id, status} response
Returns 404 for non-existent assistant
Existing tests pass (make test)

userStories.title: Tests for memory distillation pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests covering trajectory extraction and distillation to prevent regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: trajectory extraction formats messages correctly
Test: distill() creates new prompt revision when trajectories exist
Test: distill() returns None when no trajectories
Test: scheduled job skips agents without new trajectories
All tests pass (make test)
Lint passes (make format && make lint)
